story_review.one_viewing_summary: Code-scope chain only, not observed pixels. It opens close at desk height (scale 2.3) on a mostly typed Question card lying flat, about 460 px wide, with both hands at the keys. Strikes add dashes up to 0.25 s. The right index reaches the card's near edge from 0.40 s, pushes it on one eased path from 0.62 s, releases it and returns, while the card glides behind the tool's base and the camera pulls back to the tool. After a near-same-size cut, one answer slides out of the tool toward the lens and three citation cards tuck into its Sources slot. s2 frames the record edge and the dated tags, then a detail on the tags. In s3, eight strikes add eight dots, a send strike fires and the padlock at the boundary foot opens. Six strikes type the question and one push slides it to the chart edge. The later chain matches A: a stepped citation cascade, the lit share, the report tag, a single 4 s close on the clipped Not in release tags, the thread and the empty Accuracy ring, and the same answer ending.
